# Assimp and Bullet source notices

FalcoEngine uses Assimp 5.2.3 and Bullet 3.24. The original root licenses and
embedded source notices are provided in the corresponding directories.
PROVENANCE.json identifies the exact archive, source files and byte intervals.
Identical comment blocks are stored once; differing author notices are retained.

This collection covers Assimp's contrib directory and Bullet's src directory.
It conservatively includes optional code. Inclusion of a notice does not imply
that a test, example, optional codec or every Bullet target is distributed with
the application. Assimp's models-nonbsd exception remains in its root license;
these test models are not part of this notice package.

License alternatives are preserved as received. Third-party terms are not
replaced by the project's Apache-2.0 license. Notice collection is not a final
per-file attribution or publication approval. The exact source/release candidate
requires separate reconciliation, including any upstream Extras or examples
that may be included in that candidate.
